name: Agonizing Blast
desc: Pick a damaging Warlock cantrip you know. Add your Charisma modifier to its damage rolls.

name: Armor of Shadows
desc: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without using a spell slot.

name: Ascendant Step
desc: You can cast Levitate on yourself without using a spell slot.

name: Devil's Sight
desc: You see normally in Dim Light and Darkness, magical or not, out to 120 feet.

name: Devouring Blade
desc: The extra attack from Thirsting Blade becomes two extra attacks instead of one.

name: Eldritch Mind
desc: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration.

name: Eldritch Smite
desc: Once per turn when you hit with your pact weapon, you can spend a Pact Magic slot to add Force damage (1d8, plus 1d8 per slot level). A Huge or smaller target can also be knocked Prone.

name: Eldritch Spear
desc: Pick a damaging Warlock cantrip you know with a range of 10+ feet. Its range increases by 30 feet times your Warlock level.

name: Fiendish Vigor
desc: You can cast False Life on yourself without a spell slot, and you always get the maximum Temporary Hit Points.

name: Gaze of Two Minds
desc: As a Bonus Action, touch a willing creature and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. You can keep it going with later Bonus Actions and cast spells from its space if within 60 feet.

name: Gift of the Depths
desc: You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. You can also cast Water Breathing once per Long Rest without a spell slot.

name: Gift of the Protectors
desc: Your Book of Shadows gains a page where creatures can write their names (up to your Charisma modifier, minimum one). Once per Long Rest, a named creature dropped to 0 HP without being killed outright stays at 1 HP instead.

name: Investment of the Chain Master
desc: Your Find Familiar gains a 40-foot Fly or Swim Speed, can attack on your Bonus Action, can deal Necrotic or Radiant damage, uses your spell save DC, and you can give it Resistance as a Reaction.

name: Lessons of the First Ones
desc: You gain one Origin feat of your choice.

name: Lifedrinker
desc: Once per turn when you hit with your pact weapon, add 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic or Radiant damage, and you may spend a Hit Point Die to heal (roll plus Constitution modifier, minimum 1).

name: Mask of Many Faces
desc: You can cast Disguise Self without a spell slot.

name: Master of Myriad Forms
desc: You can cast Alter Self without a spell slot.

name: Misty Visions
desc: You can cast Silent Image without a spell slot.

name: One with Shadows
desc: While in Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Invisibility on yourself without a spell slot.

name: Otherworldly Leap
desc: You can cast Jump on yourself without a spell slot.

name: Pact of the Blade
desc: As a Bonus Action, conjure a Simple or Martial Melee pact weapon, or bond with a magic weapon you touch. Use Charisma for its attacks and damage, and it can deal Necrotic, Psychic or Radiant damage.

name: Pact of the Chain
desc: You learn Find Familiar and can cast it as a Magic action without a slot, with extra special familiar forms. You can give up one of your attacks so your familiar attacks with its Reaction.

name: Pact of the Tome
desc: You conjure a Book of Shadows holding three cantrips and two level 1 Ritual spells from any class list. It also works as your Spellcasting Focus.

name: Repelling Blast
desc: Pick a Warlock cantrip you know that needs an attack roll. When it hits a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 feet away.

name: Thirsting Blade
desc: You gain Extra Attack for your pact weapon only, letting you attack twice with it when you take the Attack action.

name: Visions of Distant Realms
desc: You can cast Arcane Eye without a spell slot.

name: Whispers of the Grave
desc: You can cast Speak with Dead without a spell slot.

name: Witch Sight
desc: You have Truesight out to 30 feet.

name: Aspect of the Moon
desc: You no longer need sleep and can't be forced to sleep. You get the benefits of a Long Rest by spending 8 hours on light activity.

name: Cloak of Flies
desc: As a Bonus Action, wrap yourself in a 5-foot aura of buzzing flies. You gain Advantage on Intimidation but Disadvantage on other Charisma checks, and creatures starting their turn in it take poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier. Once per Short or Long Rest.

name: Ghostly Gaze
desc: As an action, see through solid objects out to 30 feet and gain darkvision there for 1 minute (Concentration). Once per Short or Long Rest.

name: Gift of the Ever-Living Ones
desc: While your familiar is within 100 feet, dice rolled to determine hit points you regain count as their maximum.

name: Grasp of Hadar
desc: Once per turn when Eldritch Blast hits a creature, you can pull it 10 feet in a straight line toward you.

name: Improved Pact Weapon
desc: Your pact weapon works as a spellcasting focus and gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls unless it already has one. It can also be a bow or crossbow.

name: Lance of Lethargy
desc: Once per turn when Eldritch Blast hits a creature, you can reduce its speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

name: Maddening Hex
desc: As a Bonus Action, deal psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to your Hex target and to creatures you choose within 5 feet of it. You must see the target, within 30 feet.

name: Relentless Hex
desc: As a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of your Hex target, which you must be able to see.

name: Shroud of Shadow
desc: You can cast Invisibility at will without a spell slot.

name: Tomb of Levistus
desc: As a Reaction when you take damage, entomb yourself in ice for 10 temporary hit points per Warlock level. Afterward you are vulnerable to fire, have Speed 0 and are Incapacitated until the ice melts. Once per Short or Long Rest.

name: Trickster's Escape
desc: You can cast Freedom of Movement on yourself once without a spell slot, regaining the ability after a Long Rest.
